STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.description: Procurement Act 2023 threshold for goods and services contracts, sub-central authorities
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.defined_by: clause 1.4 and Appendix B footnote *** refer to the applicable Procurement Legislation and the Procurement intranet page
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure, whether it is VAT-inclusive, and its source before spend-analyst runs.

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSIONS.description: Procurement Act 2023 threshold for works contracts and concession contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSIONS.defined_by: clause 1.4 and Appendix B footnote *** ('Works and concession contracts')
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSIONS.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure and its source.

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.description: Procurement Act 2023 threshold for light touch contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.defined_by: clause 1.4 and Appendix B footnote *** ('Light Touch Contracts')
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure and its source.

RELEVANT_THRESHOLD.description: Whichever of the three statutory thresholds applies to the contract type (goods/services, works/concessions, light touch); used where the Rules say 'the Threshold' or 'the relevant Threshold' without naming a contract type
RELEVANT_THRESHOLD.note: Resolves per contract to STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES, STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSIONS or STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH. Spend data carries no contract-type field, so spend-analyst needs an auditor decision on which value to apply (e.g. goods/services as the lowest and most common).

notes: Placeholders left in the text: the document is headed 'Part []' (p1) and App A row 3 refers to 'Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan)' (p11). No version or approval date is printed; PDF metadata shows creation on 10 Nov 2025 (CLAUDE.md describes it as the Sept 2025 Part 8).

VAT conflict: clause 6.15 says Total Contract Value includes 'Value Added Tax', but the Appendix B column heading is 'Total Value exclusive of VAT'. The Appendix B bands drive the spend tests, and the spend data's 'Net amount' is ex-VAT, so the bands match it; the auditor should confirm which basis applies.

Boundary gap at exactly £500,000: App A row 2 is 'less than £500,000' and row 3 is 'Above £500,000'; App B row B2 is 'less than £500,000' and row C is 'Above £500,000'. A contract of exactly £500,000 falls in no band. Clauses 4.3 and 7.4.3 use 'over £500,000', and 7.4.2 uses 'up to £500,000'.
App A row 4 is labelled '£2.5million or more' but its cell says 'in excess of £2.5million'. Recorded as inclusive, following the row label.
Appendix B starts at 'Above £1,000' (row A): no procedure is set for contracts of £1,000 or less. The spend data starts at £500.

Statutory thresholds are not stated anywhere in the PDF (1.4, 6.5 and footnote *** point to the Procurement intranet page). Footnote *** has no matching marker in the Appendix B table. All threshold-referenced rules depend on the parameters above.

Waiver authority is inconsistent: 7.2.2 lets the relevant Executive Director and/or Chief Executive proceed at their discretion, while 7.3 says 'Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception'. Both are captured (CPR-14, CPR-15); the auditor should decide how to reconcile them.

7.2 makes waivers available only for contracts 'of more than £24,999.99'; 7.4.1 still sets S.151 approval for 'all contracts up to the Threshold'. The Rules don't say how a waiver below £25,000 is handled.
Clause 7.4.2 is garbled ('...the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved...') and cross-refers to 7.3 for urgency, although urgency is dealt with in 7.2.1.
Section 5 numbering is out of order: 5.1.1, 5.2 and 5.2.1 are items in the 5.1 list of Transparency Code publications, not separate clauses (layout view p3).
Clause 6.23 has no text; it is the heading 'Evaluations of Quotes and Tenders'.
App C row C reads 'no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken' (a word appears to be missing) and ends with '; or'.
App C row E is about variations, but its approval cell for above-Threshold values requires 'an extension report', which looks like wording carried over from row D.
Clause 6.11 refers to tenderers 'from other member states' (EU-era wording).

Advertising requirements in Appendix B are mandatory ('must') for rows B1/B2 (contract notice on CDP) but only 'should' for rows C/D. For above-Threshold contracts the mandatory advertising duty is in clause 6.10 (CPR-05).
Clause 7.5.2 names the submitter as 'the relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director' (Service Director appears twice).

rules.condition: service contract with estimated value above the Threshold for Goods & Services
rules.required_action: Consider and record how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire, per the Social Value Act 2012 and the Council's Social Value Policy.
rules.verbatim_quote: When proposing to procure or make arrangements for procuring a service contract where the estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services, consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire, as required by the Public Services (Social Value) Act 2012, and the Council’s Social Value Policy.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: Enter into a contract only where there is existing budgetary provision in the Council-approved Budget.
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.condition: every service area, monthly
rules.required_action: Report contract information to the relevant board every month in the format the Procurement Legislation requires.
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis in a format as required by Procurement Legislation.

rules.condition: any contract award
rules.required_action: Check that every awarded supplier meets the Council's minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing.
rules.verbatim_quote: Officers undertaking procurement are responsible for ensuring that all persons awarded contracts for the supplies, services or works to the Council meet the Council’s minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing.

rules.condition: contract opportunity above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold, other than a further competition under a compliant framework
rules.required_action: Advertise the opportunity on the CDP database before it appears in any other advertising medium.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database (a web-based portal provided by the Cabinet Office) prior to such advertisement appearing on any other advertising medium (such as a trade journal etc). However, where a Further Competition is undertaken via a compliant Framework Agreement, an invitation will be sent to those providers on the Framework only and no further advertisement will be required.

rules.condition: any notice issued on the Central Digital Platform
rules.required_action: Have every CDP notice approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate.
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate, who will also assist in the conduct of the procurement.

rules.condition: any contract or requirement
rules.required_action: Do not artificially split or disaggregate a contract to avoid the Procurement Legislation or these Rules.
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: electronic tender run through the Procurement Portal
rules.required_action: Specify the electronic tender format in the Portal and ITT, and keep tenders in a secure portal account locked until the specified opening time.
rules.verbatim_quote: The Council Procurement Portal and the Invitation to Tender must specify the format in which an electronic tender is to be submitted by tenderers and such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.condition: tender received after the specified opening time and date
rules.required_action: Reject late tenders unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.condition: tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal
rules.required_action: Have a Procurement Officer open tenders electronically, with an audit record kept on the e-tendering system.
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.condition: any quote or tender evaluation
rules.required_action: Evaluate quotes and tenders against criteria notified to bidders in advance.
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.condition: any contract award
rules.required_action: Award on the most advantageous, best-value quote or tender (having regard to the Social Value Policy, not lowest price alone), unless the relevant Service Director has approved exceptional circumstances in advance.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (for exceptions, in advance)
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council having regard to the provisions of the Social Value Policy, and not only on the basis of lowest price.

rules.condition: exception or waiver of competition for a contract valued at more than £24,999.99, only on the grounds in 7.2.1 (urgency, non-legislation contracts) or 7.2.2 (Executive Director / Chief Executive discretion)
rules.required_action: Waive competition for contracts above £24,999.99 only on a ground in 7.2.1 or 7.2.2, subject to the approvals in 7.4.
rules.verbatim_quote: Subject to 7.4 the requirement for the Council to conduct a competitive purchasing process, contracts with a value of more than £24,999.99, may be excepted or waived in the following circumstance:

rules.condition: exception or waiver of competition made on the discretionary ground
rules.required_action: Record in writing the reasons for an exception made at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or Chief Executive.
rules.approver: relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive
rules.verbatim_quote: at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive, acting lawfully, who may proceed in a manner most expedient for the efficient management of the Council with reasons recorded in writing.

rules.condition: any waiver of or exception to the Rules
rules.required_action: Have waivers and exceptions granted only by the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer, sought in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules, subject to exception values and delegation thresholds detailed in these Rules and/or elsewhere in the Constitution. An officer who seeks a waiver of these Rules shall do so only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.

rules.condition: exception for a contract valued up to the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain S.151 Officer approval of the exception.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.condition: exception for a contract above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.required_action: Have the S.151 Officer consult the Monitoring Officer and Executive Director, with an exception report approved by the relevant board in advance (or retrospectively where urgency prevents prior approval).
rules.approver: S.151 Officer, consulting the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director; relevant board approves the exception report
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000, the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved by the relevant board unless 7.3 applies and for reasons of urgency such prior approval is not possible in which case a report will be supplied retrospectively;

rules.condition: exception for a contract valued over £500,000
rules.required_action: Have the S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer recommend the exception to the Executive, with an exception report approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.
rules.approver: Executive, on recommendation of the S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer; relevant board and Corporate Board approve the exception report
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.condition: any exception or waiver
rules.required_action: Fully document every exception or waiver.
rules.verbatim_quote: All exceptions or waivers to these Rules must: 7.5.1 be fully documented;

rules.condition: exception or waiver where competition is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Submit a written exception report, with reasons showing the waiver is genuinely required, to the relevant board in advance.
rules.approver: relevant board (report submitted by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service or Executive Director)
rules.verbatim_quote: for any contract where the requirement to hold a competitive process is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation, be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director (which shall include reasons for the exception or waiver which demonstrate that the exception or waiver is genuinely required);

rules.condition: any exception or waiver
rules.required_action: Obtain S.151 Officer approval, recording that the reasons were considered and that the circumstances are genuinely exceptional.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver and that they are satisfied that the circumstances justifying the waiver are genuinely exceptional (applications for waivers which are a result of poor contract planning will rarely be considered genuinely exceptional);

rules.condition: use of a Purchasing Scheme (framework, DPS, dynamic market, select list, consortium or collaborative arrangement)
rules.required_action: Before using a Purchasing Scheme, obtain advice confirming the Council may use it, the purchases fall within its coverage, and it complies with the Procurement Legislation and Council requirements.
rules.verbatim_quote: An officer responsible for a procurement exercise may use a Purchasing Scheme provided that they have sought advice to confirm that:

rules.condition: contract awarded above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Produce a written report documenting key decisions and the steps leading to award.
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the relevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation (the Procurement Legislation places an obligation on the Council to document, for each procurement, key decisions and steps taken and stages leading to the award of contracts).

rules.condition: written award report produced under 9.1
rules.required_action: Keep the award report for three years.
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.condition: any procurement procedure, regardless of value
rules.required_action: Keep documentation justifying procurement decisions for three years from contract award.
rules.verbatim_quote: In addition to the above, the relevant Service Director should document the progress of all procurement procedures (regardless of value) including ensuring sufficient information is kept to justify decisions such as communications with contractors and internal deliberations, preparation of procurement documents, any dialogue and negotiation, selection and award. Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.condition: any purchase
rules.required_action: Hold written (including electronic) evidence of every purchase.
rules.verbatim_quote: There should be written evidence of all purchases (which shall include electronic evidence).

rules.condition: contract within Appendix B (total value above £1,000)
rules.required_action: Put the contract in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or delegated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer (approves the form)
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: contract document sealed on behalf of the Council
rules.required_action: Have Legal Services retain all sealed contract documents.
rules.verbatim_quote: Legal Services shall retain all contract documents that are sealed on behalf of the Council.

rules.condition: award of any contract
rules.required_action: Formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement of every award so it is recorded on the Council Contract Register.
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: Include the standard clauses from the relevant Standard Form of Agreement in every contract.
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract shall include the standard clauses set out in the relevant Standard Form of Agreement issued and updated from time to time by the Monitoring Officer or their nominated officer and available from Legal Services.

rules.condition: amendment of a Standard Form of Agreement
rules.required_action: Have any amended contract form approved by the Monitoring Officer or delegated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by the relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: any contract (clauses required 'where appropriate')
rules.required_action: Include the minimum clauses in 10.7.1–10.7.9: scope, timing, quality, insurance, default consequences, legal compliance, data protection, cancellation for improper conduct/bribery, and 30-day payment terms flowed down to subcontracts.
rules.verbatim_quote: As a minimum, where appropriate, all contracts shall include clauses setting out:

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: Complete a Data Protection Impact Assessment for every contract.
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed for all contracts to inform such clauses.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: Include enforceable specifications or technical requirements in every contract.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts shall include relevant specifications and/or briefs/technical requirements which are prepared taking into account the need for effectiveness of delivery, quality, sustainability and efficiency (as appropriate) and the need to be able to enforce the delivery of those requirements.

rules.condition: any relaxation of full indemnities in a contract
rules.required_action: Relax full indemnities only with written authorisation from both the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.condition: performance bond required for a contract estimated above £500,000 (per 11.2)
rules.required_action: Use a bond form approved by Legal Services and include it in the Invitation to Tender.
rules.approver: Legal Services (approve the form)
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.condition: contract estimated above £500,000 (per 11.2) where a performance bond is judged unnecessary
rules.required_action: Complete a written risk assessment, obtain approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property, and keep the assessment on the contract file.
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: If a performance bond is not considered to be necessary, the relevant Service Director must:

rules.condition: contract whose risk assessment identifies a need for insurance
rules.required_action: Assess each contract for risk and, where insurance is needed, set and verify adequate cover (and CIS status / professional indemnity where relevant) in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property.
rules.approver: Service Director, in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract should be assessed for risk. If the risk assessment identifies the need for insurance the Service Director must:

rules.condition: any affixing of the Council Seal
rules.required_action: Have each sealing attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or a designated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: The affixing of the Seal shall be attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council.

rules.condition: any sealing of a document
rules.required_action: Record every sealing as a consecutively numbered, signed entry in the sealing book or electronic record.
rules.verbatim_quote: An entry of every sealing of a document shall be made and consecutively numbered in a book or electronic record to be provided for the purpose and shall be signed (including a digital signature) by the person attesting the sealing.

rules.condition: goods, services, works or concession contract valued above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Seal every contract valued above the Threshold.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.condition: document executed on behalf of the Council not required to be under seal
rules.required_action: Have such documents signed by the Monitoring Officer or a designated officer, and keep a register of them.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: Where it becomes necessary to execute any document on behalf of the Council not required by law to be under seal, the Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council shall be deemed to have authority to sign such a document accordingly. A register of such documents shall be kept by the Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them.

rules.condition: selection and instruction of Counsel
rules.required_action: Have only the Monitoring Officer (or nominee) select and instruct Counsel.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer) shall have discretion to select and instruct Counsel.

rules.condition: total contract value up to the relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: Have the award made by the relevant Service Director or an officer they have nominated in writing.
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing)
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing) shall have delegated authority to award the contract.

rules.condition: total contract value above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Award by the relevant Service Director on recommendation of the S151 Officer and Monitoring Officer, with a written report approved by the relevant board.
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer); relevant board approves the written report
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) shall have delegated authority to award the contract provided a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board.

rules.condition: total contract value above £500,000 and less than £2.5 million
rules.required_action: Treat the award as a Key Decision by the relevant Service Director with the Portfolio Holder, on recommendation of the Executive Director, S151 Officer and Monitoring Officer, with a board-approved written report and Call-In / Forward Plan compliance.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer); relevant board approves the written report
rules.verbatim_quote: The award of these contracts shall be a Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) to award the contract provided: a) a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board; and b) such decision have been made in accordance with Parts [] (CallIn) and [] (Forward Plan).

rules.condition: total contract value of £2.5 million or more
rules.required_action: Obtain Executive approval (directly or by delegated authority sought through the quarterly report) before award.
rules.approver: Executive (may delegate to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval, which may be given as below. The Executive shall receive quarterly reports detailing contracts being procured and seeking delegated authority from Executive for the relevant Service Director / to award the contract following the procurement process in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer.

rules.condition: total value (ex VAT) above £1,000 and less than £25,000
rules.required_action: Seek at least one quote from an appropriate source (no advertising mandated).
rules.verbatim_quote: At least one quote must be sought from an appropriate source.

rules.condition: goods or services contract, total value (ex VAT) £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible.
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: goods or services contract, total value (ex VAT) £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Publish a contract notice on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch contract, total value (ex VAT) £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible.
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier **** (where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch contract, total value (ex VAT) £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Publish a contract notice on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch contract, total value (ex VAT) above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Run a full competitive tender seeking at least five written tenders via the Procurement Portal (advert should be placed on the Portal with information on the CDP).
rules.verbatim_quote: Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: goods, services, works, concession or light touch contract, total value (ex VAT) above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Follow Procurement Legislation procedures: full competitive tender with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement Portal (advert should be placed on the CDP).
rules.verbatim_quote: Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal.

rules.condition: competition not run because the contract is excluded under the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written Monitoring Officer approval and, where applicable, prior approval from the relevant board.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: contract governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR)
rules.required_action: Record key decisions and follow the relevant PSR process.
rules.verbatim_quote: Key decisions must be recorded and the relevant process under PSR followed

rules.condition: contract awarded under a Purchasing Scheme with no further competition (competition already run on behalf of the Council or another public body)
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written Monitoring Officer approval and, where applicable, prior approval from the relevant board.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: extension of an existing contract that provides for extension
rules.required_action: Obtain S151 Officer approval for the extension.
rules.approver: S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Approval of the S151 Officer

rules.condition: variation of scope of an existing contract (provided for in the contract or permitted by the Procurement Legislation), contract value below the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and the S151 Officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value below the Threshold prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer is required.

rules.condition: variation of scope of an existing contract, contract value greater than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain relevant board approval after submitting a report with recommendation from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer.
rules.approver: relevant board, on recommendation from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value greater than the Threshold, approval of the relevant board, following the submission of an extension report to the relevant board with recommendation from Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer

rules.condition: individual social care placement or package listed in row F (a)–(f)
rules.required_action: Record the reasons for choice of provider on the individual's case notes.
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a record of the reasons for the choice of provider is maintained on the individual’s case notes.

rules.condition: any Appendix C exemption applied to a contract with annual or total value above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Have the contract approved by the relevant board.
rules.approver: relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: In the interests of clarity where an exemption is applied all contracts with an annual or total value of more than the Threshold must be approved by the relevant board.
